name: Accessibility Standards
description: Enforces WCAG 2.1 AA compliance with semantic HTML, ARIA labels, and keyboard navigation.
content:
# Accessibility Standards (WCAG 2.1 AA)

- Use semantic HTML elements (`<nav>`, `<main>`, `<article>`, `<button>`) — not `<div>` with click handlers
- Add `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` to interactive elements that lack visible text labels
- Ensure all functionality is accessible via keyboard — test with Tab, Enter, Escape, and arrow keys
- Maintain color contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text
- Add `alt` text to all images — use `alt=""` for purely decorative images
- Never use color alone to convey information — pair with icons, text, or patterns
- Ensure focus indicators are visible — never use `outline: none` without a replacement
- Use `role` attributes only when no semantic HTML element exists for the purpose
- Implement skip navigation links for keyboard users to bypass repetitive content
- Test with a screen reader (VoiceOver, NVDA) at least once per feature
- Ensure forms have associated `<label>` elements — use `htmlFor` to link labels to inputs
